fAdded.label: Create Software Lockout Case
fAdded.desc: Set by the Close Case form when the agent chose to create a Software Lockout (Product Support deactivation) case. Read by the billing-case creation flows so the deactivation case is created at the same time as the billing case.

fAdded.label: Software Deactivation Creation Date
fAdded.desc: Scheduled creation date for the Software Deactivation (Product Support) case, captured on the Close Case form (Software Deactivation screen).

fAdded.label: Incident
fAdded.desc: The Incident (bug) this Case is attached to. Set by the Case: Bug Tracking flow. Many Cases can point at one Incident. Gives Case formulas and the Zapier integration a single-hop path to the Dev ticket fields; the standard CaseRelatedIssue junction record is created alongside it for native Incident Management UI.

fAdded.label: Account - Brand
fAdded.desc: Brand of the linked case's account (Account.Brand__c), so it can be shown in the Case Related Issues related list on Incident.

fAdded.label: Case Total Emails Sent
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Surfaces Case.Total_Emails_Sent__c onto the junction so DLRS can SUM it up to the Incident. DLRS aggregates a field on the child record, and cannot traverse CaseRelatedIssue to the Case itself - this formula is that bridge.

fAdded.label: Case Total Outbound Calls
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Surfaces Case.Total_Outbound_Calls__c onto the junction so DLRS can SUM it up to the Incident. DLRS aggregates a field on the child record, and cannot traverse CaseRelatedIssue to the Case itself - this formula is that bridge.

fAdded.label: Account - Brand
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Brand of the reporting store, pre-filled by the Case: Bug Tracking flow from Case.Case_Brand__c. Uses the same Brands global value set as the Case field, so any value valid on the Case is valid here.

fAdded.label: Affected Brand
fAdded.desc: Field is populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Affected Products
fAdded.desc: Populated by ICC via API

fAdded.label: # of Related Cases
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Count of Cases attached to this Incident via the CaseRelatedIssue junction, maintained by a DLRS rollup. Deliberately NOT the pre-existing Related_Case_Count__c, which belongs to the ICC process and is FLS-restricted to the ICC permission sets.

fAdded.label: Bug Score
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Plain number field with no calculation behind it - intended to be populated by AI scoring at a later date. Not on the screen flow.

fAdded.label: Console Errors
fAdded.desc: Verbatim console error output for the bug. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. Placeholder answers such as "See Video" are explicitly discouraged in the help text.

fAdded.label: Dev Ticket ID
fAdded.desc: ID of the bug in the Dev System (Jira / Shortcut / Azure). Written back by the Zapier integration. Unique + External ID to enforce the 1:1 relationship between a Dev System bug and a Salesforce Incident.

fAdded.label: Dev Ticket Link
fAdded.desc: Raw URL of the bug in the Dev System. Written back by the Zapier integration. Dev Ticket URL renders this as a hyperlink labelled with the Dev Ticket ID.

fAdded.label: Devl URL
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. URL captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. Distinct from Dev Ticket Link, which is the Zapier-written link to the ticket in the Dev System.

fAdded.label: Escalated?
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. One of the bug-impact questions used to triage severity.

fAdded.label: Examples
fAdded.desc: Example data that demonstrates the bug - links to pages showing the problem, product IDs, RTO numbers, etc. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow.

fAdded.label: ICC - Products Impacted
fAdded.desc: used for ICC incidents only

fAdded.label: Incident Creation Date
fAdded.desc: Populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: ICC - Incident ID
fAdded.desc:
This field is populated by ICC 
Example:  inc-002

fAdded.label: Incorrect Data
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. One of the bug-impact questions used to triage severity.

fAdded.label: Integration Status
fAdded.desc: Handshake flag for the Zapier middleware. The Case: Bug Tracking flow sets this to Pending on newly created bug Incidents; Zapier picks those up, creates the Dev System ticket, then stamps Dev Ticket ID / Dev Ticket Link and sets this to Sent.

fAdded.label: Is Inventory Affected
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. One of the bug-impact questions used to triage severity.

fAdded.label: Is Reproducible
fAdded.desc: Whether the bug is reproducible. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow and mirrored from Case.Is_Reproducible__c.

fAdded.label: Money: Collecting Incorrect Amounts
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. One of the bug-impact questions used to triage severity.

fAdded.label: # of Calls
fAdded.desc: Number of times a client has called about this bug. Manual entry only - no automation or formula.

fAdded.label: Outage Type
fAdded.desc: Populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Prevention of Saving in Key Areas
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow. One of the bug-impact questions used to triage severity.

fAdded.label: Product Artifacts
fAdded.desc: ICC Record URL or JIRA URL

fAdded.label: Products Impacted
fAdded.desc: Products impacted by this bug. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow and mirrored from Case.Products_Impacted__c. Values kept in sync with the Case picklist.

fAdded.label: Related Cases MRR
fAdded.desc: Sum of the most recent successful Recurly purchase amount across the distinct accounts of the cases linked to this incident. Recalculated when a case is linked or unlinked.

fAdded.label: Related Cases Residuals
fAdded.desc: Sum of Residuals - Avg Residual across the distinct accounts of the cases linked to this incident. Recalculated when a case is linked or unlinked.

fAdded.label: Replicable On Test or Customer Site
fAdded.desc: Where the reporting tech was able to reproduce the bug - on an internal Test Site or only on the Customer Site. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow.

fAdded.label: ICC - Scope
fAdded.desc: Populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Screenshot URLs
fAdded.desc: Links to screenshots of the bug, one URL per line. Long Text Area rather than a URL field so many links fit; images are hosted outside Salesforce to avoid file storage consumption.

fAdded.label: ICC - Severity
fAdded.desc: Field is populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Software Version
fAdded.desc: Software version the bug was observed on. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow and mirrored from Case.Software_Version__c.

fAdded.label: Status Reason
fAdded.desc: Dev Ticket status synchronised hourly from the Dev System by the Zapier integration. Only synced while the related Case Status is not Closed. Does not drive Case Status.

fAdded.label: ICC - Status
fAdded.desc: Populated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Steps to Reproduce
fAdded.desc: Numbered steps a developer can follow to reproduce the bug. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow.

fAdded.label: Store Name
fAdded.desc: The store (Account) that first reported this bug, stamped by the Case: Bug Tracking flow from the originating Case's Account. One Incident can affect many stores - the full list is the Cases attached via CaseRelatedIssue. This field records the reporter only.

fAdded.label: Suitable Workaround Available?
fAdded.desc: Whether a suitable workaround exists. Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow and mirrored from Case.Suitable_Workaround_Available__c.

fAdded.label: ICC - Summary
fAdded.desc: Field is updated via API from ICC

fAdded.label: Support Tech Name
fAdded.desc: The support tech who reported the bug. Stamped by the Case: Bug Tracking flow from the running user, so it survives Incident ownership changes and is not the same as Created By once records are transferred.

fAdded.label: System Area Affected
fAdded.desc: Area of the system where the bug shows up (screen, module, report, integration, etc.). Captured on the Case: Bug Tracking flow.

fAdded.label: ICC - Time to Resolution
fAdded.desc: Populated by ICC

fAdded.label: Total Emails Sent
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Sum of Case.Total_Emails_Sent__c across the Cases attached to this Incident. The Case-level figure is already maintained by the existing Case email-count flow, so this is a second-level sum rather than a Task rollup.

fAdded.label: Total Outbound Calls
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Sum of Case.Total_Outbound_Calls__c across the Cases attached to this Incident. The Case-level figure is already maintained by the existing Case call-count flow, so this is a second-level sum rather than a Task rollup.

fAdded.label: VIP Customer?
fAdded.desc: Bug Tracker Phase 2. Pre-filled by the Case: Bug Tracking flow at Incident creation from the reporting Account's support contract. Left editable on purpose so it can be corrected; it is a snapshot, not a live formula.

fAdded.label: Video URL
fAdded.desc: Links to screen recordings of the bug, one URL per line. Long Text Area rather than a URL field so more than one recording fits; video is hosted outside Salesforce to avoid file storage consumption.

fAdded.label: Dev Ticket URL
fAdded.desc: Displays the Dev Ticket ID as a clickable hyperlink to the bug in the Dev System.
